title: Repair bounded GMGN wallet-stat response mapping and retest eleven frozen Solana wallets
objective: Repair only the safe response mapper that left the prior Owner-authorized GMGN portfolio-stats batch unable to associate all eleven frozen public Solana wallets with allowlisted aggregate fields. Add a small versioned pure parser which receives an in-memory JSON value and emits only: a matching frozen wallet identity, provider-reported period PnL aggregate when present, provider-reported win-rate aggregate when present, provider-reported trade-count aggregate when present, parser version, and stable safe mapping/unavailable codes. The parser must tolerate documented envelope, array, nested-record and wallet-keyed map layouts without retaining or emitting arbitrary keys, values, provider text, raw payloads or error text. All numeric values remain GMGN-borrowed and unverified; a `--period 7d` or `--period 30d` value is not cumulative/all-time profit. Add focused pure unit tests using synthetic sanitized fixtures only. Then, only if `GMGN_API_KEY` is present (check existence only), strictly Base58-decode and validate every frozen wallet as exactly 32 bytes before spawning any CLI process. Run exactly two manual read-only `gmgn-cli portfolio stats` child invocations, each containing all eleven wallets: one 7d and one 30d. Capture process stdout/stderr only in memory; make no retry, pagination, Helius call, fallback or other GMGN command. Write only a sanitized report containing the frozen wallet, unverified user label, period, parser version, source classification `borrowed_unverified`, mapping status, the three allowed aggregate values when safely parsed, and stable safe codes. Explicitly state that the requested endpoint's observed period window does not establish cumulative/all-time profit, wallet quality, Alpha tier, clustering or chain-verified PnL.
forbidden_actions: Do not call any chain or provider other than the two explicitly bounded GMGN CLI portfolio-stats invocations; do not call Helius in this task.
Do not run more than two GMGN CLI invocations, retry, paginate, discover, add, infer or substitute wallets, or issue a request before all eleven frozen wallets pass strict Base58/32-byte validation.

Do not print, persist, commit or quote API keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw provider payloads, arbitrary provider keys or text, full exception text, transaction signatures, counterparties, token mints or per-trade records.

Do not claim all-time/cumulative profit, realized chain-verified PnL, win rate, wallet quality, wallet classification, common ownership, clustering, address-library eligibility, complete history, token recommendation or Alpha N/R/SR/SSR/UR tier.
Do not add a provider, chain, database, cache, queue, address library, scheduler, production write, trading, signing, swap or order operation.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.
